what_it_does: Updates the osrs-tracker RuneLite plugin to use Vulkan Video Encode (H.264) for client-side video clip encoding. When a user's GPU supports the codec, video frames are encoded locally to H.264 MP4 format instead of sending raw MJPEG frames to the backend server, reducing bandwidth consumption and server transcoding costs.

description_match.summary: PR description accurately represents the change: shipping Vulkan Video Encode for client-side H.264 encoding to replace server-side MJPEG transcoding, with clear cost/bandwidth benefits.

unsafe_operations.what: Asynchronous HTTP POST requests to configured OSRS Tracker API endpoint with base64-encoded video payload (videoBase64 parameter). No HTTPS enforcement visible at API client level, relies on OsrsTrackerConfig.PRODUCTION_API_URL hardcoded value.
System.getenv() call to read OSRS_TRACKER_DEV environment variable for enabling dev mode config options. Could expose sensitive configuration if environment is not properly isolated.

bottom_line: This PR updates the video recording infrastructure to leverage GPU-accelerated H.264 encoding, reducing server load and bandwidth usage with no obvious security vulnerabilities in the shown code.
